sn46.8:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca Upavāṇo āyasmā ca Sāriputto Kosambiyaṃ viharanti Ghositārāme || || 2.
sn46.8:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto sāyānhasamayam paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Upavāṇo tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Upavāṇena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn46.8:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ sarāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantam Upavāṇam etad avoca || || 3.
sn46.8:2.1: Jāneyya nu kho āvuso Upavāṇa bhikkhu Paccattaṃ yonisomanasikārā evaṃ susamāraddhā me sattabojjhaṅgā phāsuvihārāya saṃvattantīti || || 4.
sn46.8:2.2: Jāneyya kho āvuso Sāriputta bhikkhu Paccattaṃ yonisomanasikārā evam sūsamāraddhā me satta bojjhaṅgā phāsuvihārāya saṃvattantīti || ||
sn46.8:3.1: Satisambojjhaṅgam āvuso bhikkhu ārambhamāno va janāti || || Cittañ ca me suvimuttam thīnamiddhañca me susamūhataṃ uddhaccakukkuccañ ca me suppaṭivinītaṃ āraddhañca me viriyam aṭṭhikatvā manasikaromi no ca līnan ti || la-pe ||
sn46.8:3.2: Upekhāsambojjhaṅgam āvuso bhikkhu ārambhamāno va jānāti Cittañ ca me suvimuttaṃ thīnamiddhañ ca me susamūhatam uddhaccakukuccañ ca me suppaṭivinītam āraddhañ ca me viriyam aṭṭhikatvā manasīkaromi no ca līnan ti || ||
sn46.8:3.3: Evaṃ kho āvuso Sāriputta jāneyya Paccattam yonisomanasikārā evaṃ susamāraddhā me satta bojjhaṅgā phāsuvihārāya saṃvattantī
